name: email

scripts.conformance: MAIL_CONFIG=/nonexistent.json npx tsx ${CAK_HOME:-$HOME/agent-kernel}/bin/cak.ts conformance --subprocess "node dist/main.js" --contract mail.search --args '{"account":"default","limit":5}' && MAIL_CONFIG=/nonexistent.json npx tsx ${CAK_HOME:-$HOME/agent-kernel}/bin/cak.ts conformance --subprocess "node dist/main.js" --contract mail.read --args '{"account":"default","uid":1}' && MAIL_CONFIG=/nonexistent.json npx tsx ${CAK_HOME:-$HOME/agent-kernel}/bin/cak.ts conformance --subprocess "node dist/main.js" --contract mail.send --args '{"account":"default","to":["someone@example.com"],"subject":"test","text":"hi"}'

description: CAK 插件：邮件（mail.search@1 / mail.read@1 / mail.send@1）— IMAP 查读 + SMTP 发，账号别名制
